newsitem.title: CHINA: China to set up $24 mln chemical JV with U.S. firm.
newsitem.headline: China to set up $24 mln chemical JV with U.S. firm.

text.p: China's Dong'e Chemical Industrial Group Co and Rade Management Corp of the United States have signed a contract to set up a chemical joint venture, the Xinhua news agency said on Thursday.
Total investment in the project in the eastern province of Shandong would be $24.0 million, of which the Chinese partner would provide 30 percent while Rade would invest 70 percent, Xinhua said.
The joint venture would use the latest technology from the United States to make chemicals, the agency said.
Xinhua did not say what the venture would produce but said Dong'e was a nitrogenous fertiliser maker. It gave no further details.
